title: lastrea lindmanii
intro: Lastrea lindmanii, commonly known as Lindman's fern, is a species of fern in the family Athyriaceae. It is a medicinal plant that has been used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Lindman's fern include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of Lindman's fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing fever, relieving cough and cold, and supporting the immune system.
